title: Paul thanks the church in Philippi for their gift
description:
Paul expresses joy that the church in Philippi has once again shown care for him by sending help through Epaphroditus.  
He tells them that he has learned to be content both in poverty and in plenty, and that he can do all things through Christ who strengthens him.  

He reminds the Philippians that from the very beginning of the gospel, when he left Macedonia, they were the only church that shared with him in giving and receiving, and that they also sent help to Thessalonica.  
The gift is described as a fragrant offering that God accepts with pleasure, and Paul promises that his God will meet every need they have according to His riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
